title: Read the fixed output with chat_completion in OutputFixingParser

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1066] Read the fixed output with `#chat_completion` in `Langchain::OutputParsers::OutputFixingParser`; `#completion` is `nil` or not implemented on the Anthropic, Ollama, Mistral AI and Google Gemini chat responses, so fixing never succeeded there.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1068] Call the cohere-ruby 1.0 (v2 API) `chat` and `embed` from `Langchain::LLM::Cohere`, which raised `ArgumentError` with the gem version the gemspec requires; v1 `chat_history` messages are converted, and `CohereResponse` reads v2 and v1 bodies.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1065] Leave the tools out of the request when the Ollama assistant adapter gets `tool_choice: "none"`, and stop logging `tool_choice`/`parallel_tool_calls` warnings on every call for the Assistant's defaults.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1063] Send `tool_choice: "auto"` from `Langchain::Assistant` once a forced tool (`"any"` or a function name) has been called since the latest user message, so a run with a forced tool can finish instead of calling the tool until `max_turns`.

@@ -142,14 +142,28 @@

   describe "#parse" do
+    it "reads the fixed output from a chat response that has no #completion (Anthropic, Ollama)" do
+      [
+        [Langchain::LLM::Anthropic.new(api_key: "123"),
+          Langchain::LLM::Response::AnthropicResponse.new({content: [{type: "text", text: json_text_response}]})],
+        [Langchain::LLM::Ollama.new,
+          Langchain::LLM::Response::OllamaResponse.new({"message" => {"role" => "assistant", "content" => json_text_response}, "done" => true})]
+      ].each do |llm, response|
+        parser = described_class.from_llm(llm: llm, parser: kwargs_example[:parser])
+        allow(llm).to receive(:chat).and_return(response)
+
+        expect(parser.parse("Whoops I don't understand")).to eq(json_response)
+      end
+    end
+
     it "parses without need for fixing when completion text is already valid" do
       parser = described_class.new(**kwargs_example)
       expect(parser.parse(json_text_response)).to eq(json_response)
     end
 
     it "when completion text is invalid, sends fix prompt to llm and parses fixing response" do
       parser = described_class.new(**kwargs_example.merge(prompt: fix_prompt_template_example))
-      allow(parser.llm).to receive_message_chain(:chat, :completion)
+      allow(parser.llm).to receive_message_chain(:chat, :chat_completion)
         .with(prompt: match(fix_prompt_matcher_example))
         .with(no_args)
         .and_return(json_text_response)
